_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.no_cards: Ga go na dikarata le ga bjale.
player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Modiri a le mongwe vs Dealer

📖 TSEBISO YA GAME:
• O thoma ka {start_chips} chips
• Deki e le nngwe ya dikarata tša 52 (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• O bapala kgahlanong le dealer (ntlo)
• Mafase a bjalo a latela mokgwa wa Ultimate Texas Hold'em: o bea ANTE le BLIND bets, o amohela dikarata tše 2 tša hole, o kgetha go bapala PLAY bets ka mafase a bjalo, o senola dikarata tša setšhaba le go bapetša bjalo bja gago bja dikarata tše 5 kgahlanong le bjalo bja dealer. Sepheo sa gago ke go oketša mafelo a gago (ge o na le bjalo bjo bobe), ao o loketše mabedi a gago (ge o na le bjalo bjo mpe).
• Game e fela ge o fihla 0 chips goba ka tlase ya fihla ya mafase (LOSS) goba o phetha mafase a 1000 ka chips (WIN)

💰 MOKGWATHLO WA BETTING:
• ANTE: Mokgwa wa kgetho ${ante} o mongwe le o mongwe wa mafase
• BLIND: Mokgwa wa kgetho ${ante} o mongwe le o mongwe wa mafase
• PLAY: Mokgwa wa go bapala o sa kgethegile. Ka mafase a bjalo, o ka kgetha mokgwa o le mongwe wa mafelo a latelago: (${ante4} ge o dirwa ka PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} ge o dirwa ka FLOP, goba ${ante} ge o dirwa ka RIVER. O ka goga le ka river, o tlogela bjalo, le go se be mokgwa.)

🎴 MOKGWATHLO WA GO BEA KARATA:
• O amohela dikarata tše 2 tša hole
• Dealer o amohela dikarata tše 2 tša hole (tše di sa bonwago)
• Dikarata tše 5 tša setšhaba di beilwe ka tlase
• Dikarata tša setšhaba di senolwa ka mafase a bjalo

🏆 MOKGWATHLO WA GO KGETHA DEALER:
• Dealer o swanetše go ba le bjalo bjo bobe (dikarata tše 2 tša mofuta o mongwe) go kgetha, o diriša dikarata tše 2 tša bjalo le dikarata tše 5 tša setšhaba.
• Mokgwa wa go kgetha wa dealer o ama mafelo a betting, ao a tlaleletšwe ka morago.

🎮 MAFASE A GAME LE DITIRO:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Ditiro: [4x] (${ante4}) goba [check]
  • [4x]: Be mokgwa wa ${ante4} PLAY, o senola dikarata tše 3 tša setšhaba
  • [check]: Ga go na mokgwa wa go oketša, o senola dikarata tše 3 tša setšhaba

📋 FLOP:
  • Ge mokgwa wa 4x o beilwe: Mokgwa wa [skip] o fela (o senola dikarata tše 2 tša setšhaba ka bošego)
  • Ge mokgwa wa 4x o se beilwe: [2x] (${ante2}) goba [check]
  • [2x]: Be mokgwa wa ${ante2} PLAY, o senola dikarata tše 2 tša setšhaba
  • [check]: Ga go na mokgwa wa go oketša, o senola dikarata tše 2 tša setšhaba

📋 RIVER:
  • Ge mokgwa wa 4x goba 2x o beilwe: Mokgwa wa [skip] o fela (o tšwela pele go showdown)
  • Ge mokgwa wa PLAY o se beilwe: [1x] (${ante}) goba [fold]
  • [1x]: Be mokgwa wa ${ante} PLAY, o tšwela pele go showdown
  • [fold]: O tlogela bjalo, o lahleha ANTE le BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Dikarata tše di senolwa le go lekolwa
  • Bjalo bja dikarata tše 5 bja bjalo bja 7 (2 hole + 5 setšhaba)
  • Mokgwa wa betting o ahlaahlwa ka mokgwa wa payout

💎 MOKGWATHLO WA PAYOUT:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer ga a kgethe: PUSH (mokgwa o bušetšwa)
  • Dealer o kgetha & o wina: 1:1 payout (mokgwa + mafelo)
  • Dealer o kgetha & o lahleha: Mokgwa o lahleha
  • Tie: PUSH (mokgwa o bušetšwa)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Ga o amiwe ke mokgwa wa go kgetha wa dealer
  • O wina: Mokgwa o bušetšwa le mafelo a oketšegilego ka bjalo bja gago
  • O lahleha: Mokgwa o lahleha
  • Tie: PUSH (mokgwa o bušetšwa)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Ga go na mafelo a oketšegilego

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Ga o amiwe ke mokgwa wa go kgetha wa dealer
  • Papatšo e lekantšwe: Bjalo bja gago bja bjalo kgahlanong le bjalo bja dealer
  • O wina: 1:1 payout (mokgwa + mafelo)
  • O lahleha: Mokgwa o lahleha
  • Tie: PUSH (mokgwa o bušetšwa)

🎯 MAFASE A BJALO A POKER (Bobe go Mpe):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 ya mofuta o mongwe
  2. Straight Flush: Dikarata tše 5 tše di latelago tša mofuta o mongwe
  3. Four of a Kind: Dikarata tše 4 tša mofuta o mongwe
  4. Full House: 3 tša mofuta o mongwe + 2 tša mofuta o mongwe
  5. Flush: Dikarata tše 5 tša mofuta o mongwe
  6. Straight: Dikarata tše 5 tše di latelago
  7. Three of a Kind: Dikarata tše 3 tša mofuta o mongwe
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs tša mofuta o mongwe
  9. One Pair: 2 tša mofuta o mongwe
  10. High Card: Karata e kgolo e wina

⌨️  DITIRO TŠA DITOKEN:
• [4x] goba [play bet 4x]: Be mokgwa wa ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY
• [2x] goba [play bet 2x]: Be mokgwa wa ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY
• [1x] goba [play bet 1x]: Be mokgwa wa ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY
• [check] goba [c]: Check (ga go na mokgwa wa go oketša)
• [fold] goba [f]: Fold (o tlogela bjalo)
• [skip] goba [s]: Skip go fase e latelago (ge mokgwa o se a hlokomele)

💡 DITŠHELETE TŠA STRATEGY:
• Bjalo bja tshepetšo bja bjalo bja go kgetha (pairs, dikarata tše kgolo) bjalo bja kgetha mokgwa wa 4x
• Leba mokgwa wa go kgetha wa dealer - bjalo bja mpe bjalo bja push ge dealer ga a kgethe
• Mokgwa wa BLIND o ka ba o le mabedi ka bjalo bja tshepetšo (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Leba tshelete ya gago! Ge e fihla 0 goba ka tlase ya fihla ya mafase, o lahleha.

⚠️  DITŠHELETE TŠE DI TLHAGIŠAGO:
• ANTE le BLIND bets di a kgethegile mafase o mongwe le o mongwe
• PLAY bets di sa kgethegile le di le stratetiki
• Ikgantšha gore o bea mokgwa o swanetše, le mokgwa o le mongwe ka nako.
